gdacs-drought-dr-1018332.summary: Drought has affected much of Europe since spring 2026, according to the sources. In July, the JRC reported that half of the EU and UK was under drought at some intensity, with 9% at alert level. The EU Drought Observatory said drought was still critical in most of Europe in late September. Its 28 October analysis was not clear enough to confirm the current state. A forecast of a wetter November may ease the drought but not end it. The feed's start date of 21 December 2025…

gdacs-drought-dr-1027450.summary: A drought affecting parts of East Africa and the Central Sahel began on 21 May 2026. Chad, Ethiopia and South Sudan report the most detailed impacts, including rainfall deficits, delayed rainy seasons and dried water sources. FEWS NET said in August that Chad's rainy season was not yet fully established. As of 3 November 2026 the drought was ongoing, and the notes give no end date. Several sources link it to El Niño-related rainfall deficits.
